evaluation.interpretation_policy: Signals identify synthetic changes in location or short-term successive variation; they do not confirm a physical root cause, production state, or recipe action.

dependence.limitation: Lag-1 screening cannot prove independence or exclude higher-order dependence, drift, mixtures, or seasonality.
dependence.method: lag-1 sample autocorrelation with approximate ±1.96/sqrt(n) screening bound

baseline.interpretation_policy: Synthetic candidate I-MR parameters are frozen for method evaluation only; they are not operational control limits or specifications.
